title: PolicyConfig
description: Machine-readable shape of the stellar-agent-guard contract's PolicyConfig (SPEC §3 fields, §8 validation). Vendored by stellar-agent-guard-sdk ahead of contracts #61; the _provenance header in the vendored wrapper carries source, commit, digest, and the refresh protocol.

per_tx_cap.description: Maximum spend per single authorization, in stroops (§8 bullet 1: >= 0).

window_cap.description: Rolling-window spend ceiling, in stroops (§8 bullet 1: >= 0; bullet 2: nonzero requires window_secs nonzero).

dms_grace_secs.description: Dead-man-switch grace in seconds; 0 disables the switch (§8 bullet 1: >= 0).

active_from.description: Policy activation time, unix seconds (§8 bullet 1: >= 0).

active_until.description: Policy expiry, unix seconds; 0 = never expires (§8 bullet 1: >= 0). The bullet 4 cross-field comparison (0, or strictly greater than active_from) is code-enforced: active_window_inverted.

paused.description: When true, every authorization is blocked (§4 gate order).

allow_any_recipient.description: When false, only `recipients` may receive transfers (§8 bullet 5: empty recipients with this false is a shape-valid no-op).

assets.description: SAC contract addresses spendable by the agent. Items are strings; full StrKey validity is code-enforced (invalid_address), duplicates too (duplicate_asset).

recipients.description: Allowlisted account addresses (G...). Full StrKey validity is code-enforced (invalid_address), duplicates (duplicate_recipient), entry cap (max_recipient_entries_exceeded, bullet 8), and intersection with blocked_recipients (recipient_conflict, bullet 9).

blocked_recipients.description: Denylisted account addresses; same code-enforced checks as recipients (duplicate_blocked_recipient, recipient_conflict).

protocols.description: Allowlisted non-SAC protocol calls. Per-rule address checks are code-enforced (duplicate_protocol, self_as_protocol).

fns.description: Function allowlist; null allows any function. An empty array is schema-valid but contract-rejected (empty_protocol_functions, code-enforced); entries must be non-empty strings (minLength) and unique (duplicate_protocol_function, code-enforced).

recipient_window_caps.description: Optional per-recipient window caps. Entry cap and duplicate/self checks are code-enforced (max_recipient_entries_exceeded, duplicate_recipient_window_cap, self_as_recipient_cap).

cap.description: Per-recipient rolling-window ceiling (§8 bullet 1: >= 0; bullet 3: nonzero requires window_secs nonzero via the allOf branch below).

allOf.description: §8 bullet 3: any per-recipient cap > 0 requires window_secs > 0.
